searchScope: High-leverage immutable 7.0 dataset, entity-diff, field-evidence, version-manifest, and lineage artifacts for Genshin v2 population.

scopedFrontiers.searchScope: Independent, immutable, exact-7.0 field or mechanic evidence for the 55 candidates mapped from the official Venti, Diona, Yae Miko, Cyno, and Stellar Swirl changes.
scopedFrontiers.negativeResult: genshin-db 7.0 strictly binds the target version but is one correlated Fandom/GenshinData family; its four affected character display records are unchanged across 6.7/7.0 and do not prove runtime mechanic fixes. Official notices identify changes but do not supply complete replacement fields. No second independent family currently provides immutable exact-7.0 mechanic fields for the four characters or the complete 12516 claim set.
scopedFrontiers.reopenTrigger: A provider-owned immutable artifact that binds exact 7.0 revision/raw/field digests and independent lineage to the affected mechanic fields, or a new official field table/erratum with complete candidate claim coverage.

providersExamined.result: Official 7.0 live-version head is strict for version discovery, but is not a complete field dataset.
